config.title: Card Component

intro.title: Card Component
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a reusable Card component in Vue to display information like a title, description, and image in a clean, styled box. You will learn how to structure a Vue single-file component with a template, script, and style section. The core concept involves using Vue's reactive data and props to make the card content dynamic and customizable. You'll work with basic HTML structure, CSS for styling, and Vue's component system to create a modular UI element.
intro.usecase: Card components are fundamental building blocks in modern web interfaces, appearing everywhere from e-commerce product listings and social media feeds to dashboard analytics panels and content management systems. In real Vue applications, developers use cards to display user profiles, blog posts, dashboard metrics, or product items—each with consistent styling and interactive elements like buttons or hover effects. For example, an e-commerce site might use a card component to show product images, descriptions, and 'Add to Cart' buttons in a grid layout. Mastering card creation helps you build reusable, maintainable UI patterns that scale across complex applications.

objectives: Construct a Vue component with a template, script, and style section
Initialize and bind data properties to display dynamic content in the card
Apply computed properties to manipulate and format card data
Configure props to pass data from a parent component to the card
Implement event handling to control user interactions with the card
Integrate conditional rendering to show or hide card elements based on state
Render the card component within a parent component and pass required data

steps.title: Import Vue and define the Card component
steps.instruction: Import Vue and define a functional component named Card with a template section.
steps.hint: In Vue, you can create a component by defining a function that returns an object with a template property.
steps.seedCode: // Import Vue and define the Card component
steps.expectedOutcome: The Card component is defined and ready to have its template filled with content.
successCriteria: Vue is imported and a functional component named Card is defined with a template section.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're close. Make sure you've imported Vue and defined a component named Card with a template property.
steps.feedbackWrong: Check that you've imported Vue and created a functional component named Card with a template section.

steps.title: Add component props for title and description
steps.instruction: Inside your Card component, add a props configuration with two properties: 'title' (type String) and 'description' (type String).
steps.hint: In Vue, you can define props using the 'props' option. For simple type definitions, you can use an object with property names as keys and the expected type as values.
steps.expectedOutcome: The Card component will accept 'title' and 'description' as props, making it reusable with different content.
successCriteria: The component has a props configuration with 'title' and 'description' properties, both typed as String.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're on the right track, but make sure both 'title' and 'description' are defined as String type props.
steps.feedbackWrong: The props configuration is missing or incorrect. Check that you've defined both 'title' and 'description' as String type properties.

steps.title: Initialize reactive data for likes count
steps.instruction: Inside the component's configuration object, add a data function that returns an object with a property named likes set to 0.
steps.hint: In Vue, reactive data is defined using a data function that returns an object. This makes the likes property reactive so Vue can track changes to it.
steps.expectedOutcome: The component will have reactive data initialized with a likes property set to 0, ready to be used in the template.
successCriteria: A data function is added that returns an object with a likes property initialized to 0.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're on the right track, but make sure your data function returns an object with exactly one property: likes set to 0.
steps.feedbackWrong: The data function is missing or doesn't return the correct object structure. Remember to add a data function that returns { likes: 0 }.

steps.title: Create incrementLikes handler method
steps.instruction: Add a methods object to your component with an incrementLikes function that increases the likes count by 1.
steps.hint: In Vue, methods are defined in a methods property. The function should access the likes data property using 'this'.
steps.expectedOutcome: Your component will have a methods object containing an incrementLikes function that increments the likes count when called.
successCriteria: The component has a methods property with an incrementLikes function that increases this.likes by 1.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You've added a methods object, but check that incrementLikes properly increments this.likes by 1.
steps.feedbackWrong: The methods object or incrementLikes function is missing or incorrect. Remember to define methods: { incrementLikes() { this.likes += 1; } }.

steps.title: Add likes display with reactive data
steps.instruction: Inside the template, add a span element that displays the current likes count from the component's data.
steps.hint: Use double curly braces {{ }} to output reactive data in the template. The likes data property is accessible directly by its name.

successCriteria: A span element is added to the template that displays the likes data property using {{ likes }}.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.

steps.title: Add like button with click handler
steps.instruction: Add a button element inside the card container after the likes display span. Use the @click directive to call the incrementLikes method when clicked.
steps.hint: The button should be a standard HTML button element. Use @click to bind the incrementLikes method as the click handler.
steps.analogousExample:
// Adding a button with click handler in Vue
<button @click="incrementLikes">Like</button>
steps.expectedOutcome: The card component will have a button that, when clicked, increases the likes count by 1.
successCriteria: A button element with @click directive calling incrementLikes is added to the template.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.

steps.feedbackWrong: The button element with click handler is not present. Make sure to add a button with @click="incrementLikes" inside the card container.
